note: A retrospective painting of a scene labelled 1833, not a photograph or an eyewitness record. The building at left has a gable roof over horizontal log courses, a single visible sash and an off-centre doorway in the long elevation, a small framed opening in the visible gable, and one chimney rising through the roof. The caption places it near the east end of the later Lake Street bridge. This picture informs an inferred elevation for Hogan's store; it supplies neither a surveyed location nor a dimension and cannot establish the building's survival or use on 1 July 1835.
